verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Amplitude Experiment can turn a flag off when something goes wrong and can manage flags through APIs from CI or scripts. Neither is documented versioning, change review, or rollback to a prior version of a configuration. A kill switch is an adjacent control, and API access is a developer building block, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
